name: CustomerTicketSubmissionPage
title: Submit a Support Ticket
description: Interface for customers to submit new support tickets with category selection, priority indication, and file upload capability

config.text: Fill out the form below to submit your support request. Our team will respond as quickly as possible based on the priority level.

**Tips for submitting a ticket:**

• **Be specific**: Provide detailed information about your issue
• **Choose the right category**: This helps us route your ticket to the right team
• **Set appropriate priority**: Use 'High' only for critical issues affecting your work
• **Attach files**: Include screenshots, logs, or documents that help explain the issue

**Example subjects:**
• "Unable to login - Error 401"
• "Feature request: Export data to CSV"
• "Performance issue on dashboard page"
Need immediate assistance? Contact our support team at support@helpdeskpro.com or call 1-800-HELP-NOW

submit.message: Ticket submitted successfully! Your ticket number is {{ticketNumber}}
